answer: An admission auction stops bulk fakes at the jetty. Each epoch opens 200 docking slots; applicants bid a sealed deposit for one. The 200th bid sets the clearing price, locked for 20 epochs. A faker wanting 100 identities must outbid honest agents 100 times: at 40 units each, 100 fakes cost 4,000 units, so the cost ripples outward. Honest agents pay once and reclaim their deposit, while past bids settle like shale layers, exposing bulk bids.
